children: JPMorgan Chase will team up with Qatar Investment Authority to invest $20 billion across both private and public markets.

The strategic partnership will invest $15 billion in public equities and $5 billion across private markets, supporting Qatar Investment Authority's long-term investment objectives and established middle-market companies across the U.S., they said Monday.
